name: Human Rights, Human Like
original_name: ヒューマンライツ・ヒューマンライク
source:
''You have been sent to the future and will be kept by an AI. We will pick you up in a week maximum. Until then.''
A game where you spend a week being kept by your humanoid robot brother!

[translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8884]Novel Game[/url]]
translation:
“你被送到了未来，将由人工智能保管。我们最多会在一周内接你。直到那时。”
在一款游戏中，你将被你的人形机器人兄弟照顾一周！

[翻译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8884]小说游戏[/url]]
